verdict.rationale: Salv is a commercial AML/compliance platform, and whether its source is openly licensed is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability, a repository, or an open license. The downloadable OpenAPI definition (public.yaml) is an API spec, not product source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
